column1: # Engine members a remote caller of a served client never reaches (multi-user lane L3; test/rust-served-member-lists.test.ts).

# STORE_RETURNING_MEMBERS, with a one-line reason. Reason `ruling A default`: the baseline of 2026-11-28 (multiuser
# d0a230d4ac), local-only because no served parity file proves the member for a remote caller. That reason is frozen:
# its rows only leave. A new row names its own reason. Keep rows sorted (LC_ALL=C) and unique.
